protocol.signals: Prior completed Alpaca IEX daily bars only; provider daily closes are not guaranteed consolidated closing-auction prices. Six fixed rules. Raw reversal is not a classified non-fundamental liquidity shock.
protocol.entry: First observed valid ask from actual market open +5 through +30 minutes, never a reconstructed fill.
protocol.exit: First valid bid from actual close -12 minutes through the close on holding session 1 or 5; missing exits are not evaluable.
protocol.quote_validation: Bid/ask finite, positive, ordered; bid >= $5; quote age between -5 and 90 seconds; spread / midpoint <=0.5% and spread / ask <=0.5%.
protocol.cost_formula: gross=exit_bid/entry_ask-1; net=gross-0.002-(entry_ask-entry_bid)/entry_ask-(exit_ask-exit_bid)/exit_ask; stress=net-0.003. Ask/bid already includes spread; the extra spread terms are conservative additional assumed penalties, not measured fees.
protocol.reporting_window: Twenty broker-calendar entry sessions fixed before the first observation, followed by four possible swing maturation sessions. No optional extension to obtain a winner; descriptive results only.
protocol.denominator: Preregister every eligible rule/symbol/horizon opportunity. Missing prior-session data and non-overlap exclusions are reported separately. Missing entry or exit quotes are not evaluable, never zeros or fills. Net means condition on evaluable observations; show their count against all preregistered opportunities.
protocol.unit: Holding-horizon returns per unit opportunity, cash=0 for observed signal abstentions; average within entry date then across entry dates. Symbols and variants are correlated; entry dates are not proven independent observations.
protocol.comparison: Historical bar-open/close screens differ from this forward quote protocol. They are hypothesis-generation evidence only.
protocol.authority: No broker orders, allocated capital, automatic promotion, causal controls, annualized return or profitability claim.

report.summary: 2026-10-29 premarket: no trade and no shadow price plans. Prioritize swing reversal for further research, followed by earnings drift and regime comparisons. All six intraday screens lost money after assumed costs. New mechanisms remain proposed pending tested code; existing contracts remain unchanged. No new executable contracts are justified by the available evidence.

hypotheses.claim: Priority research lead: the existing three-session decline below -3% may precede a five-session rebound. Holdout net/stressed means were +8.97/+5.32 bp as mean holding-horizon returns per screened unit opportunity; development stressed mean was slightly negative.
hypotheses.mechanism: Temporary selling pressure can reward liquidity provision. Fundamental deterioration, adverse selection and overnight gaps can overwhelm a rebound. [Nagel](https://www.nber.org/papers/w17653) studies liquidity provision, without validating this particular long-only rule.
hypotheses.falsification: Freeze the screened rule and holding period before forward observation. Reject advancement if net expectancy is nonpositive, fails the stressed-cost test, or depends on one entry-date cluster. Compare against cash and matched market exposure; separately report event-driven declines.

hypotheses.claim: Deprioritize both screened reversion rules: reversal and pullback holdout net means were -2.74 and -4.25 bp as mean holding-horizon returns per screened unit opportunity. Smaller losses than the baseline do not establish profitability.
hypotheses.mechanism: Liquidity pressure might reverse, but a negative prior return can also reflect persistent information. Spread crossing and opening price discovery can consume a small rebound. [Nagel](https://www.nber.org/papers/w17653) provides a mechanism, not evidence for next-open intraday execution.
hypotheses.falsification: Evaluate the unchanged rules prospectively with mandatory same-session exits. Reject advancement unless net and stressed expectancy become positive with uncertainty accounted for. Daily-bar results cannot validate stop ordering, execution timing or catalyst causality.

hypotheses.claim: Deprioritize generic intraday continuation: breakout and five-session momentum holdout net means were -5.63 and -8.33 bp. No intraday catalyst edge was tested.
hypotheses.mechanism: Gradual information absorption could sustain buying, while false breakouts and crowded entry points create losses. [Jegadeesh and Titman](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/j.1540-6261.1993.tb04702.x) examine three-to-twelve-month momentum; that horizon does not establish a one-session edge.
hypotheses.falsification: Keep the two screened rules separate and unchanged. Reject advancement if prospective after-cost expectancy remains nonpositive. Any opening-range or catalyst version requires its own proposed specification, timestamped intraday observations and tested implementation.

hypotheses.claim: Keep continuation as a losing comparison family. Swing breakout fell from +16.25 bp in development to -0.18 bp in holdout; momentum fell from +18.31 to -10.45 bp.
hypotheses.mechanism: Underreaction can produce persistence, but reversal risk and turnover can erase gains. [Momentum Crashes](https://www.nber.org/papers/w20439.pdf) documents losses around panic-state rebounds in momentum portfolios; its portfolio construction differs from this laboratory.
hypotheses.falsification: Freeze both original rules and five-session horizons. Reject advancement if prospective net and stressed results remain nonpositive or gains disappear after accounting for market exposure. Do not select breakout solely because its inspected holdout loss was smaller.

hypotheses.claim: Proposed research only: positive year-over-year quarterly EPS change combined with a positive announcement-session market-adjusted return may predict subsequent five-session drift. Seasonal EPS change is not an analyst-consensus surprise.
hypotheses.mechanism: Investors may incorporate earnings implications gradually. [Bernard and Thomas](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/016541019090008R) report delayed earnings-related price responses, without establishing this five-session specification. Guidance, accounting differences and an already completed price adjustment are failure modes.
hypotheses.falsification: First verify official release timestamps and contemporaneously available EPS. Preregister entry at the next open after the complete announcement session and a fifth-session-close research exit. Reject if incremental net returns versus matched announcement controls are nonpositive under base or stressed costs.

hypotheses.claim: Research whether the already registered regime gates improve intraday outcomes. The screened stock-and-SPY trend condition still lost 11.38 bp as a mean holding-horizon return per holdout unit opportunity.
hypotheses.mechanism: Policy surprises can change equity risk premiums and liquidity. [Bernanke and Kuttner](https://www.federalreserve.gov/econres/feds/what-explains-the-stock-market39s-reaction-to-federal-reserve-policy.htm) study unexpected policy changes; a calendar event or unchanged rate alone does not identify a bullish regime.
hypotheses.falsification: Compare each existing gate separately with its unchanged parent on identical prospective opportunities. Reject the improvement claim if exposure-adjusted net returns and downside measures do not improve. Record abstentions, missed rebounds and event-day costs; do not redefine risk_on or risk_off.

hypotheses.claim: Research existing regime gates without assuming that broad-market confirmation helps. Swing market-confirmed trend lost 20.17 bp as a mean holding-horizon return per holdout unit opportunity, versus 10.29 bp for stock-only trend.
hypotheses.mechanism: Broad market conditions may affect financing expectations and correlated drawdowns. However, avoiding stressed markets can miss liquidity-driven recoveries, consistent with the mechanism in [Evaporating Liquidity](https://www.nber.org/papers/w17653).
hypotheses.falsification: Preserve existing gate definitions and parent exits. Compare calendar-time returns, exposure, drawdown and missed opportunities using entry-date and holding-period blocks. Reject the improvement claim if apparent gains are explained entirely by reduced exposure or vanish under stressed costs.

hypotheses.claim: SHADOW research only: anticipated earnings volatility may be expensive enough that a large stock move still fails to produce a profitable long straddle.
hypotheses.mechanism: Jump-risk compensation, retail demand, time decay and spreads can outweigh realized movement. [De Silva, So and Smith](https://ide.mit.edu/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Retail_Options.pdf?x14396=) document earnings-related retail option losses. Conversely, an unusually large jump can dominate the premium; volatility decline alone does not imply a profitable short position.
hypotheses.falsification: Before observing outcomes, specify an event-relative observation window and contract-selection method, then collect synchronized indicative bid/ask snapshots and official event timestamps. Compare ask-paid/bid-received outcomes with midpoint diagnostics, including separately disclosed fees. Reject the overpricing claim if its result disappears across spread and fee sensitivities. No contracts or fills are assumed here.

hypotheses.claim: Proposed SHADOW diagnostic: investigate whether pre-event implied-versus-subsequent-realized variance differs across scheduled macro-event and ordinary periods. No option-return claim follows from this comparison.
hypotheses.mechanism: Scheduled announcements concentrate uncertainty, but elevated implied volatility can compensate for jump risk. [Cboe's methodology](https://cdn.cboe.com/resources/vix/VIX_Methodology.pdf) defines VIX as a thirty-day SPX volatility measure; it is not a single-stock earnings forecast.
hypotheses.falsification: Preregister matched thirty-day horizons, event labels and nonoverlapping evaluation blocks. Use squared volatility with consistent annualization and verified SPX closes. Reject the event-premium claim if the event/non-event difference disappears after conditioning on volatility level. Missing matched data means no estimate; a variance difference cannot be booked as option P&L.

sources.title: Evidence that stock prices do not fully reflect the implications of current earnings for future earnings
sources.takeaway: Public indexed publisher abstract reports predictable subsequent earnings-announcement reactions. Full-text retrieval failed; the proposed five-session strategy is an extrapolation.

sources.takeaway: Public submissions and XBRL APIs require no authentication or API keys. Documentation was reviewed; company-specific releases and comparable historical EPS were not collected.

sources.title: What Explains the Stock Market's Reaction to Federal Reserve Policy?
sources.takeaway: Official research abstract distinguishes unexpected policy changes and links equity responses primarily to expected excess returns; it supplies no current directional signal.

sources.title: FRED two-year Treasury yield series

sources.title: Losing is Optional: Retail Option Trading and Expected Announcement Volatility
sources.takeaway: Author-hosted working paper documents option overpayment, large spreads and delayed exits around earnings. Its results do not establish an executable opposite-side strategy.

sources.title: Cboe Volatility Index Methodology
sources.takeaway: VIX measures thirty-day expected equity-market volatility using SPX options. No current option chain, implied move or tradable premium was established.

sources.title: Cboe Historical VIX Data
sources.takeaway: Official page provides daily VIX closing-history downloads. Index history alone cannot reconstruct historical option contracts, spreads or fills.

uncertainties: Twelve focused search queries were used. Research relied only on public sources; several papers were available only through public abstracts or indexed excerpts.

The supplied screen is user-provided evidence, not independently reproduced. Dataset SHA-256: 6e8053b7dc16b75561212471426e7f3143f6221140a350f822160bd7931c875d; last session 2026-10-28. Its inspected holdout cannot validate newly chosen variants.

Complete holdout net means, in bp per screened portfolio day: intraday trend -13.97, pullback -4.25, breakout -5.63, reversal -2.74, momentum -8.33, market-confirmed trend -11.38; swing trend -10.29, pullback -4.07, breakout -0.18, reversal +8.97, momentum -10.45, market-confirmed trend -20.17. These are not per-trade returns or allocation-level paper P&L.

Swing reversal has only 20 holdout evaluation periods and 73 correlated signals. Its slightly negative development stressed result, present-day universe selection and lack of constrained portfolio simulation weaken the apparent lead.

Shared forward protocol: freeze specifications before observations; require both at least 20 forward sessions and 30 completed samples per variant. These are minimum collection thresholds, not proof. Report uncertainty using session/entry-date blocks and account for overlapping swing holdings and multiple comparisons.

Retain the supplied 20 bp base and 50 bp stressed equity round-trip cost assumptions for comparisons. They are not observed execution costs. Report turnover, exposure, net expectancy, drawdown, adverse excursions where observable, and cost sensitivity; daily bars cannot resolve intraday stop/target ordering.

No new experiment contracts were emitted: four of the five permitted exact_change filters are already registered in each equity branch. The remaining higher_confidence_085 lacks demonstrated score calibration and known parent versions. New earnings, timing and volatility mechanisms require tested implementation before registration.
Only existing experiment IDs are linked to regime hypotheses. Their definitions, versions and accumulated forward observations were not supplied; no contract is amended or presumed to have passed.

No fresh symbol-level quotes, entry levels or complete issuer event checks were verified. Shadow plans therefore remain empty. Current risk_on/risk_off classification, macro surprises and post-release reactions remain unknown.

SEC filing availability does not guarantee the earliest earnings-release timestamp or comparable EPS. Preserve original publication times and as-filed values to avoid look-ahead from amendments and restatements.

No synchronized indicative option chain was verified; direct retrieval of the Cboe quote page failed. Option fees, contract availability, multipliers, spreads and fills remain unknown. Options hypotheses remain SHADOW research only.

Academic portfolio results often use long-short construction and different horizons. Transfer to long-only, cash-funded $10,000 branches is unestablished. All existing sizing, loss thresholds, drawdown pauses and same-session intraday exit requirements remain unchanged.

validation.summary: Reviewed all nine hypotheses. All quoted screen figures match the attached record after rounding. They are holding-horizon returns averaged across unit opportunities, including abstentions, not daily portfolio returns or returns per executed trade. The corrected units resolve the earlier interpretation error. Underlying data and calculations were not independently reproduced. Acceptance means source/method review only; no profitability, executable fills, new contracts or risk-policy changes are validated.

hypotheses.reason: [Nagel](https://www.nber.org/papers/w17653) supports the liquidity-provision mechanism. The attached screen confirms +8.97/+5.32 bp holdout net/stressed five-session opportunity means and slightly negative development stressed results. Frozen rules, cluster checks and matched-market comparisons are concrete. Only 20 holdout entry-session groups, selection bias and assumed costs limit inference; portfolio expectancy remains unknown.

Both negative means match the attached screen. [Nagel](https://www.nber.org/papers/w17653) supports reversal mechanics, while [trading-cost research](https://www.nber.org/papers/w20721.pdf) cautions against high-turnover reversal profitability. Unchanged prospective rules, stressed costs and same-session exits provide concrete tests. Daily-bar execution and stop ordering remain explicitly unverifiable.

The attached screen confirms -5.63/-8.33 bp one-session opportunity means; five-session momentum describes the lookback, not the holding period. [Jegadeesh–Titman](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/j.1540-6261.1993.tb04702.x) supports longer-horizon momentum only, as acknowledged. Separate frozen forward comparisons are falsifiable, with timestamped intraday data required for any catalyst variant. Short-horizon transfer remains unknown.

All development and holdout figures match the attached five-session screen. The independently located [Momentum Crashes abstract](https://www.nber.org/papers/w20439) confirms losses during rebounds following declines and high volatility, while its construction differs from this long-only laboratory. Frozen horizons, market-exposure comparisons and stressed-cost rejection criteria are concrete. Limited entry-session groups and inspected holdout rankings prevent profitability conclusions.

The [Bernard–Thomas publisher source](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/016541019090008R) remained inaccessible; its substantive attribution was not independently verified. [SEC documentation](https://www.sec.gov/search-filings/edgar-application-programming-interfaces) verifies free access, not comparable EPS or earliest release timestamps. Entry and exit timing are concrete, but EPS accounting, session mapping and matched-control selection need frozen definitions before testing.

The -11.38 bp opportunity mean matches the attached screen. [Bernanke–Kuttner](https://www.federalreserve.gov/econres/feds/what-explains-the-stock-market39s-reaction-to-federal-reserve-policy.htm) supports policy-surprise effects, not these particular gates. Existing gate definitions, parent versions and contemporaneous input availability remain missing. Supply them and prespecify improvement statistics; market confirmation is not evidence that the registered macro gates work.

The -20.17/-10.29 bp five-session opportunity means match the attached screen. [Nagel](https://www.nber.org/papers/w17653) supports the counterargument that stress avoidance can miss reversals. Gate definitions, versions and timestamped inputs remain unverified. Calendar-time drawdown requires a constrained portfolio simulation; it cannot be inferred from these opportunity averages.

The [author-hosted research](https://ide.mit.edu/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Retail_Options.pdf?x21090=) supports earnings-related straddle underperformance and substantial spreads. However, observation windows, expiry, strike selection, fees and a free synchronized quote source remain unspecified. Freeze these and distinguish premium overpricing from spread-driven losses. Ask-entry/bid-exit calculations would remain indicative SHADOW scenarios, never executable fills.

[Cboe methodology](https://cdn.cboe.com/resources/vix/VIX_Methodology.pdf) verifies thirty-calendar-day SPX implied volatility. Matched horizons, nonoverlapping blocks and conditioning on volatility make the diagnostic falsifiable. Freeze event labels and the realized-variance estimator, including conversion of VIX percentage units before squaring. Matched free SPX data remain unverified; close-based variance misses intraday variation, and no option P&L follows.

draft.summary: 2026-10-29 premarket: no trade and no shadow price plans. Prioritize swing reversal for further research, followed by earnings drift and regime comparisons. All six intraday screens lost money after assumed costs. New mechanisms remain proposed pending tested code; existing contracts remain unchanged. No new executable contracts are justified by the available evidence.

limitations: Exploratory historical screen; never counted toward forward promotion or paper P&L.
Fixed present-day liquid universe: survivor/selection bias; adjusted historical data is not a point-in-time universe.
Prior-session features, next-open entry; daily bars cannot test intraday catalyst timing, stops or fills.
65/35 chronological split with boundary-label purge. Holdout has been inspected; future changes require new forward evidence.
Equal-weight unit opportunities, cash for abstentions; no constrained portfolio simulation. Swing entry-day clusters overlap across symbols.
20bp base / 50bp stressed round-trip costs are assumptions; IEX-only OHLC is not consolidated executable liquidity.
Twelve fixed trials reported together; rankings are not statistical proof and correlated signals are not independent evidence.

review.summary: October 29 was a missed forward-testing session. Recorded ending equity totals $30,000, unchanged across three allocations. Premarket research occurred, but no trading-performance lesson or new strategy variant is justified.
observations: Each branch reports $10,000 ending equity and an unpaused state. These snapshots establish recorded balances, not successful execution or continuous session coverage (equity records 2302–2307).

The incident explicitly reports no broker fills or forward shadow observations. Premarket exploration and validation were recorded separately; research activity must not be counted as forward trading evidence (events: exploration_completed 11:37:40Z; missed_session incident 22:49:34Z).
